name: Tri
description: The spitter, drawn alone in the same leather and wool as Dot, but not on Dot's frame: the belly changed all of it. Tri let the hive's work be done on it so it could throw acid, and the body is the price. The belly is swollen into a sac wider than the chest, the wool tunic stretched over it and creased where it pulls, with a stitched seam running down the front where it was opened and closed, and a leather band buckled round it held up by two straps over the shoulders. The chest leans back over the hips to balance it, the legs under it are short and thick in wool trousers with the shins wrapped and heavy ankle boots, and the arms hang out from the sides because they cannot hang straight. Nothing is carried — nothing that would get in the way of a body like this — but the dead organ on its cord above the belly. The head is `ss.lib.tri-head` composed at a fifth of its size, tilted back a little with the chin up: a leather cap with goggles pushed up on it, a leather muzzle with a brass spout at the front stained where the acid comes out, a throat swollen into a gland under the jaw. No feelers — those are Dot's weapon. It stands back on its heels and breathes with the belly, and it walks in a slow lurch. No skin anywhere but the face and the throat. Drawn facing +x; the game flips it.

idle.description: standing back on the heels with the belly forward: the sac does the breathing, a slow swell that lifts the band round it; the chest rocks a hair behind it, the head lifts on the in-breath, and the arms, held out from the belly because they cannot hang straight, drift out and back

walk.description: a slow lurch: short steps on the short thick legs, a heavy drop as each foot lands, the upper body rolling forward and back over the hips a beat behind the feet and the belly a beat behind that, the head nodding with it, the arms swung wide and loose for balance
